ruleDefinitions.name: System Network Connections Discovery - Linux
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects usage of system utilities to discover system network connections

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\/who$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/w$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/last$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/lsof$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/netstat$")) AND  NOT ((parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/usr\\/bin\\/landscape\\-sysinfo.*") AND process_path = RGX("\\/who$")))
